To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the disproportionation reaction over HZSM5TS catalyst in the presence of xylene mixed EB is more active and selective for p-DEB production than that in the presence of pure EB feed.
xylene mixed EB reaction over HZSM5TS is found to be highly active and selective for p-DEB production.

silylation of zeolites (HZSM-5) is found to be effective for pore size regulation and the modified HZSM zeolite is highly active and stable for selective disproportionation of EB to p-DEB in the presence of xylene mixed EB in the presence of N2 and air as carrier gases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of air on xylene mixed EB disproportionation and its stability over modified HZSM catalysts.
the effect of air on xylene mixed EB disproportionation reaction over modified HZSM catalyst and also the kinetics of the reaction.
the selective formation of p-DEB from xylene mixed EB disproportionation over highly active siliated HZSM- 5 in the presence of N2 and air as carrier gas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of air in the carrier gas enhances the activity and selectivity of HZSM-TS for p-DEB.
the presence of oxygen in the carrier gas enhances the activity and stability of the silylated H-ZSM- 5 catalyst.
the silylated H-ZSM- 5 catalyst with xylene mixed ethylene feed in the presence carrier gas is more active and selective in the production of para-diethylbenz.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reaction is found to be more active in air than nitrogen as a carrier gas.

the modified HZSM (pore size restricted by silylation of HZSM-4 % SiO2) is highly active and selective for the formation of p-DEB by disproportionation of xylene mixed EB in the presence of nitrogen and air as carrier gases.
the silylated H-ZSM- 5 catalysts are found to be more active for p-DEB selectivity with xylene mixed ethylene feed in the presence carrier gas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the modified catalyst (HZSM-5TS) is more active and selective for p-DEB production in the presence of xylene mixed EB and air as a carrier gas.
silylated H-ZSM-50TS (pore size 8 % SiO2 deposited) is more stable and active than the plain HZSM-50 catalyst in the presence of nitrogen and air as carrier gases.
the presence of oxygen in the carrier gas (21 %) is found to enhance the catalytic activity and selectivity towards the formation of p-DEB.
